description: Dear Friends and Neighbors, If you are not registered to vote and would like to vote in the upcoming primary on June 9th, you must register by this Sunday, May 10. Voters can register in person, online, or through a mail-in registration application by visiting scVOTES.org. Registering online will require a driver’s license or an identification issued by the DMV. You may register in person at the Richland County Elections and Voter Registration office located at 2020 Hampton Street, Columbia,
